answer: Because the timing is recorded against the onyx challenge, the beacon audit can replay the nectar history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 225 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1367 identities would post 3537 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
